description: a cylinder r 4, h 12 whose side face is bounded by its two circles and no seam, as ISO 10303-42 allows and NIST's CTC-03, FTC-10 and FTC-11 write it: the reader leaves the face without a seam and its own checker refuses the body (L4, zero signed area), where it should add the seam as it rebuilds a degenerate edge. Shrunk from those parts (ADR-0026 §4); Open CASCADE reads it, healed, to π·16·12
source: written by hand for this fixture, shrunk from NIST parts (ADR-0026 §4)
